comments.body:
## RCA closed, fix implemented

**Evidence chain (all reproduced locally on git 2.55):**

1. The failing assertion is scaffolding, not the code under test: `_drop_packed` delegates to
   `_drop_loose`, whose `assert loose.is_file()` requires the just-written blob to be in
   git's LOOSE storage shape. `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` had already resolved the oid in CI,
   so the object existed and was READABLE — it had simply moved into a pack.
2. `_freeze_gc` sets `gc.auto=0` before the ticket under test is written, and I confirmed by
   probe that the setting survives `create_ticket` and that `git maintenance run --auto`
   respects it. So no FOREGROUND maintenance could have packed the blob.
3. The only remaining mutator is one that read git's config BEFORE the freeze and outlived
   it. `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` over this test's own fixture sequence recorded 7 maintenance
   children, **2 of them `--detach`**, both attributed by trace2 `cmd_name` to `commit`
   inside `rebar init`. Every child spawned after the ensure sweep is `--no-detach`.
4. `git pack-objects` was ruled out directly: it does not remove the loose copy (measured).

**Fix:** invoke the existing `_gc_config_unit` at the top of `_mount_or_create_branch`,
addressed at the host repo whose `.git/config` the tracker worktree shares, so the posture is
pinned before the store's first commit instead of after it. Re-running the trace probe:
2 detached children before, **0 after**.

**Regression test:** `tests/unit/test_init_leaves_no_detached_upkeep.py` — asserts over
`_git_upkeep.maintenance_children()` that no `--detach` child survives `rebar init`, with a
positive control that the trace actually covered a `commit` so the assertion cannot pass
vacuously. Confirmed RED without the fix (reports both detached argv lists) and GREEN with it.
A second case asserts the three settings' values and that `gc.auto` stays unset.

Note for the record: change 2682 is NOT superseded by ea08483d / 4c9940348148. Those landed
the scanner lane as advisory under ADR 0114; 2682 is that ADR's intended follow-up promotion
into the Verified vote. Its diff touches only workflow YAML, `check_verify_gate_parity.py`
and unrelated test modules — nothing on the failing test's path, and nothing that changes the
pytest cell's selection or parallelism.

## Negative result: none of today's three scheduled `main` failures share this mechanism

Checked runs 33967035958 (`0033662b5534`), 33956014400 (`9d5a7278c892`) and 33950878570
(`a33333b8709a`). **Zero of the three** match the detached-maintenance race. No failure in any
of them involves a git object, a pack, a clone, or anything the object database could have
mutated under. Do not fold them into this ticket.

What they actually are — **at least three independent producers, one of them a genuine
nondeterministic main-red**:

| producer | where | runs | shape |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_reconciler_apply_bindings.py::test_reconcile_once_threads_composed_runtime_transport_into_apply` — `AssertionError: the apply phase must forward the composed runtime's transport as client=` | sweep (macos, py3.14t, py3.15) | **3 of 3** | deterministic; identical assertion on every non-default tier, and it does NOT fail on ubuntu py3.13 — an environment-conditioned real defect, not a race |
| `test_terraform_code_review_tools.py::test_ac3_verifier_routing_gets_distinct_fresh_terraform_session` — `assert (2 >= 2 and 1 == 2)` | **build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)** — the gating cell | **2 of 3** (33956014400, 33950878570; passed in 33967035958) | **nondeterministic** — same assertion, same cell, passes on one of three identical scheduled runs. This is the second main-red producer still at large and the one worth dispatching |
| Windows-tier platform failures | sweep (windows) | 3 of 3 | several unrelated causes: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'` at collection; `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'flock'`; copied-store worktree re-pointing (`references worktrees outside itself`); backslash-vs-forward-slash path assertions (`test_check_criteria_vocabulary`); `npm not on PATH` in the e2e toolchain tier; `check_deploy_manifest` path-separator drift; and a network-guard trip |

So the "~3 reds a day" is **not** one race. The sweep tiers are failing deterministically and
have been red on every run; the only nondeterministic signal in the gating cell is the
terraform verifier-routing test, which is unrelated to this bug and needs its own
investigation.

Corollary for this ticket's severity: the earlier `test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py`
`git clone … exit 128` (run 33970977028) remains the one corroborating instance of THIS
mechanism beyond the 2682 failure, so the fix stays a p2 correctness/stability fix — real, and
closing an ADR-0051 invariant hole, but not the explanation for main's current noise.

## Effect on an already-pinned repository: none, measured

`_gc_config_unit` is check-then-act, and the new early call is a literal no-op once the
settings are converged. Measured on an initialized store:

```
unit on an ALREADY-PINNED repo -> EnsureOutcome(id='gc-config', status='ok', ...)
config bytes unchanged: True | mtime unchanged: True
second init_repo rc-ok, config bytes unchanged: True
```

Not one byte and not even an mtime touch — it reports `ok` and returns.

Two further reasons a regression here would be contained rather than felt everywhere:

- The new call sits inside `_mount_or_create_branch`, which `init_core` reaches **only** when
  no valid tracker worktree is already mounted. Re-running `rebar init` on an initialized repo
  returns from the idempotency branch long before it.
- **A fresh worktree in this project never reaches it at all.** `make worktree` produces a
  linked worktree whose `.git` is a FILE, which `init_core` routes to `_init_via_symlink` —
  symlinking to the main repo's existing (already-pinned) store — before the init lock and
  before `_mount_or_create_branch` is called. Confirmed against this change's own worktree.

The only path that executes the new call is genuine first-time store creation, which is
exactly the window the bug lives in.

## First `make verify` was contended, not red — external gate-slot holders

`make verify` returned **2** (`12 failed, 19873 passed, 80 skipped in 4175.21s`). None of the
12 is attributable to this change, and all 12 have one external cause.

Nine failed with `GateCongestedError: gate admission refused: all 4 concurrent gate slot(s)
on this host are ...`, and the other three (`test_plan_review_cli_retry`) with `assert 11 == 2`
— a retry-count knock-on of the same refusal:

```
test_eval_solver.py::test_completion_verifier_case_runs_and_scores
test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py::test_orchestrator_degrade_key_unregenerable_records_unsigned
test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py::test_orchestrator_degrade_ssh_keygen_unavailable_records_unsigned
test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_verify_completion_reuses_an_owned_ticket_session_without_recapture_or_close
test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_verify_completion_threads_one_pinned_view_through_library_and_agent_reads
test_plan_relation_snapshot.py::test_review_plan_preflight_tolerates_unrelated_untracked_tracker_files
test_plan_review_cli_retry.py::{test_cli_retry_is_compatible_with_no_sign,
                                test_cli_retry_refuses_unreviewed_ticket_with_zero_calls,
                                test_cli_retry_resumes_and_persists_lineage}
workflow/test_gate_error_sidecar.py::test_plan_review_outage_writes_gate_error_and_still_degrades
workflow/test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py::{test_existing_verdict_readers_skip_gate_error_record,
                                              test_gate_error_verdict_not_coerced_to_fail}
```

**Direct evidence of the cause, not an inference.** `rebar.llm.gate_admission.gate_admission`
holds one of `max_concurrent_gates` flock'd slot files that are HOST-WIDE, and a process list
taken during triage found three live gate runs from a DIFFERENT checkout
(`/Users/joeoakhart/comment-gates-current`) holding them:

```
2238   .venv/bin/rebar review-plan autositic-scarlet-clam --output json
44353  .venv/bin/rebar review-plan congenial-cibophobic-goosefish --output json
66047  .venv/bin/rebar review-plan aberrant-scabrous-esok --output json
```

Three of the host's four slots were held by another session, leaving one for four xdist
workers. Slots are released from a `finally` and by flock-on-process-death, so nothing had
leaked — the holders were live. Left running; they are another session's work.

Re-running the affected modules with the change applied: **33 passed** in 261s. The run also
took 1:09:35 against AGENTS.md's documented 20-25 min, which independently confirms the host
was saturated.

This is contention on an LLM gate semaphore, orthogonal to a `git config` ordering change at
store init — this change cannot reach it. Not treated as a pass: a clean `make verify` is
re-running and its verdict will be recorded here. The change is pushed as Gerrit **2721**,
where CI runs on uncontended Linux runners.

## Symptom

`tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py::test_tree_listed_ticket_blob_missing_from_object_database_fails_closed[packed-_drop_packed]`
failed the GATING cell (`pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)`, `not integration and not external`) of
GitHub Actions run 33989904007, casting a spurious `Verified -1` on Gerrit change 2682
(ticket d645-8f51-0ff9-4070), whose diff touches only workflow YAML, a parity script and
unrelated test modules — nothing on this test's path.

```
tests/unit/test_pinned_ticket_view.py:657: in _drop_loose
    assert loose.is_file(), f"expected {blob_oid} to be loose; got {loose}"
E   AssertionError: expected 78f74eda8e30b413767ae9771c467593a28ca9c8 to be loose
1 failed, 19942 passed, 82 skipped
```

The test failed on its own scaffolding, before exercising `PinnedTicketView` at all. The
`loose` sibling parametrization passed in the same run, so the storage shape was decided
nondeterministically, not systematically.

## Root cause

`_mount_or_create_branch()` in `src/rebar/_commands/init.py` creates the tracker worktree and
makes the store's first commits, and `_commit_precommit()` makes another — all BEFORE
`_run_ensures_logged()` runs `_gc_config_unit`, the ensure that pins
`gc.autoDetach=false` / `maintenance.autoDetach=false` (ADR 0051, bug 88eb).

Inside that window git is at its DEFAULTS, so each `git commit` spawns
`git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` — a background child that OUTLIVES the command
that spawned it and mutates the SHARED object database of the host repo the tracker worktree
is linked into. Measured with `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` replaying this test's own fixture sequence
(git 2.55): 7 maintenance children, of which **2 are `--detach`**, both attributed by trace2
`cmd_name` to `commit` inside `rebar init`; every later child (post-ensure) is `--no-detach`.

The test's `_freeze_gc()` sets `gc.auto=0` to make the blob's storage shape constructible, but
a detached child that started BEFORE the freeze already read git's default config and cannot
be called back. When it repacks, `git prune-packed` removes the loose copies — including the
freshly written `*-CREATE.json` blob the test then asserts is loose. `git rev-parse` still
resolved the oid in CI, which is only possible if the object had moved into a pack.

This is the SAME mechanism the store already root-caused for fixture bare remotes and
documented in `tests/_git_upkeep.py`: `subprocess.run()` returning is not a happens-before
edge for that repository's object database. Bugs 88eb-2beb-65f5-4bc0, dca1-f641-caeb-4df4,
b394-6198-6010-42f7, 5b74-5d8f-a6b4-4674 and 57d2-e356-7eb4-4bf5 all closed instances of it;
none covered rebar's own init window, which is the remaining gap. It is also a real
ADR-0051 invariant hole in the product, not only a test problem: a detached repack of the
shared object DB runs OUTSIDE rebar's write lock, which is precisely the store-corruption
hazard ADR 0051 exists to prevent.

## Fix

Pin the posture BEFORE the store's first commit rather than after it: invoke the existing,
idempotent `_gc_config_unit` at the top of `_mount_or_create_branch`, against the host repo
whose `.git/config` the tracker worktree shares. No new mechanism and no new config keys —
the same unit already writes the same three settings to the same file, just too late. The
post-bootstrap `_run_ensures_logged()` sweep is unchanged and now converges as a no-op.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: `rebar init` on a fresh repository leaves ZERO `--detach` maintenance children, proven
  by a `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` assertion over `_git_upkeep.maintenance_children()`.
- AC2: The `gc.autoDetach` / `maintenance.autoDetach` / `gc.auto` settings written are
  unchanged in value and location; `_gc_config_unit` remains their single definition.
- AC3: `make verify` is green.

## Definition of done

- A regression test that fails before the fix and passes after it.
- `make verify` green; change lands through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
